acceptance_criteria.statement: A previously unseen (repo, pr) head builds and dispatches one review and records the head.
A head already seen dispatches nothing.
A changed head dispatches at the new head and heads_to_review reports it.
The verify_review and lane_dryrun lanes are findings_only and lane_may_approve is False for both.
An unknown lane kind raises instead of being treated as an approver.

observable_behavior: a new head dispatches once and a repeated head does nothing
a moved head dispatches at the new head
both advisory lanes report findings_only and cannot approve
outcome.summary: Trigger the review pipeline once per pull-request head change, tracking (repo, pr) -> head so a new or updated PR dispatches exactly one review bee. The two advisory cron lanes call the same pipeline and remain findings-only: they never post APPROVE.
